games.name: Blockate
games.desc:
Blockate is a sandbox building game where you can create worlds, or play them. In Blockate, you're able to create worlds and build in those worlds with blocks. You can use different shapes, colors, materials, and many things to build up your world. You can also have friends play your worlds, and even help build them.

Controls: 
Q - Toggle Spectator, Building, and Delete mode.
Shift + Q and Shift + E - Swap color
F and G - Change shape
Z and X - Change material
Alt - Copy block's properties
C - Toggle Main Menu
V - Toggle World Menu
U - Open Sticker Wheel
Say !cmds for a list of commands.

games.name: Stand Power
games.desc:
"Stand Power" is largely inspired by the series "JoJo's Bizarre Adventure".

COMMANDS:
!rejoin -> Allows you to rejoin the same server in-game.
!pity -> Displays your current shiny stand chance pity percentage.
!trade (player name) -> Sends a STAND trade request to the specified player.
!confirm (player name) -> Confirms the TRADE REQUEST that you've sent.
!accept (player name) -> Both parties must enter this command to finalize the trade (this comes after the "!confirm" command).
!giveitem (player name) -> Gives the targeted player the item you're currently holding.

🌐Available on:

・💻 PC
・📱 MOBILE
・🎮 CONSOLE (Note: A keyboard and mouse are required for gameplay)

💻PC Controls:
・F to BLOCK
・L to open INVENTORY
・CTRL to RUN
